post.summary: Suno Voice Create Custom Voice API
post.description:
:::warning Document updated
If you have already completed the integration process previously, you can still access the old version document at: Old version address (https://docs.kie.ai/old-model/suno-api/suno-voice-generate)
:::
Generate a custom Suno Voice after the user reads the validation phrase.

Submit the original validation task ID, the user's verification audio URL, and optional voice metadata such as `voice_name`, `description`, and `style`. The system will validate the recording and create a reusable custom voice.

For better results, upload or record a singing voice sample. Clean acapella vocals usually produce the most accurate voice profile.

:::tip
This endpoint is free.
:::

## Query Task Status
:::tip[]
In the production environment, it is recommended to use the `callBackUrl` parameter to receive automatic notifications when the custom voice is generated, rather than polling the status endpoint.
:::

## Use the Generated Voice

Get the Voice ID: the Voice ID is the taskId of your validation-phrase task, which create-voice also returns in resultJson.resultUrls[0]. create-voice returns success immediately; that only means the request was accepted. The voice is ready when the validation-phrase task changes to state "success" (usually within a minute). If it changes to "fail", the recording did not pass verification. Receive the result on the validation-phrase task's callBackUrl (data.status is "success" or "fail"), or poll Get Task Details with that taskId. To use the voice, pass the Voice ID as persona_id together with persona_model: "voice_persona" in Generate Music.

model.description: The model name to use for generation. Required field.

callBackUrl.description:
The URL to receive generation task completion updates. Optional but recommended for production use.

- System will POST task status and results to this URL when generation completes
- Callback includes generated content URLs and task information
- Your callback endpoint should accept POST requests with JSON payload containing results
- Alternatively, use the Get Task Details endpoint to poll task status
- To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification) for signature verification implementation

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

verify_url.description: Audio URL for the user's recording of the server-returned `validateInfo` validation phrase. For best voice generation results, recording the phrase in a singing voice rather than plain speech is recommended. [Required]

singer_skill_level.description: Singer skill level. Supported: beginner, intermediate, advanced, professional

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
